about: Settings of the profile banners (1500x500, the same picture works for Bluesky and Mastodon). One block per account: the key is the file name banner-<key>.png. theme = which drawing of banner.html to use (cozy or retro); title, subtitle, byline = text on the picture (English only); accent = colour of the small bar and the glow. A new niche = a new block here (and a new drawing in banner.html if none fits). Then run: node design/banners/render.mjs (needs the playwright package; one key only: node design/banners/render.mjs retro). Fonts in fonts/ are Bricolage Grotesque and DM Sans (SIL Open Font License), the same as the site. The text starts at x=330 so the round avatar in the bottom-left corner and the centre crop on phones do not hide it. Bluesky takes files up to 1 MB, Mastodon up to 2 MB.
